## Problem

## Change

<!-- Add before/after evidence for visible changes, including platform and theme. Otherwise write N/A. -->

## Rollout notes

## Checklist

- [ ] The title follows `type(scope): description`.
- [ ] The PR addresses one problem or feature.
- [ ] Tests cover behavior changes, and affected checks have been run.
- [ ] Validation results and any unverified behavior are documented.
- [ ] Visible changes include screenshots or recordings, where applicable.
